breakdown.description: The prompt treats equal axial force as if it implied equal normal stress in both stepped segments; the force is the same in series, but the stress depends on each segment’s area.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification correctly computes separate stresses for each segment using their respective cross-sectional areas (σ1 = P/A1 and σ2 = P/A2), rather than treating the stress as identical in both segments. This properly reflects that while the axial force P is the same in both series segments, the normal stress differs because the areas differ.

breakdown.description: The prompt enforces a common elongation for the two stepped segments, which is a compatibility condition for parallel members, not for segments connected in series.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification correctly treats the segments as series members by computing individual elongations (δ1 and δ2) and summing them (δ_total = δ1 + δ2). There is no enforcement of a common elongation (parallel compatibility condition), which was the error in the incomplete prompt.
